description.content: OAuth 2.0 client credentials authentication endpoints for obtaining access tokens.

Obtains an OAuth 2.0 access token using the client credentials grant type. The request must be encoded as application/x-www-form-urlencoded and include the client_id, client_secret, and grant_type parameters. The returned access token should be included as a Bearer token in the Authorization header of subsequent API requests.

Returns a paginated list of responses for a specific survey. Responses are sorted by creation date in descending order, with the most recent responses returned first. Supports cursor-based pagination with a maximum of 100 responses per page. Available on Ask Scale plans.

The Hotjar REST API provides programmatic access to Hotjar data and functionality. It allows developers to export survey responses, list surveys, automate user lookup and deletion requests, and integrate Hotjar data into external tools and workflows. The API uses OAuth client credentials authentication, returns JSON responses, supports cursor-based pagination, and is rate limited to 3000 requests per minute. It is available on Observe and Ask Scale plans.
